response.overview: I don't think I was particularly moved by the sexuality as much as I was by the loneliness underneath it. There's something painfully familiar about people constantly searching for connection but never quite knowing how to ask for it. Everyone seemed to be carrying an unspoken ache, trying to find in others what they couldn't quite make sense of within themselves. It made me think about how intimacy isn't necessarily about being physically close, but about feeling emotionally recognized. Perhaps we're all just looking for someone with whom we can put down our defenses, untangle our little messes and exist without having to pretend.
